Suite.Good.detail: Actual production Noise suite rejects an empty key, contradicting its unrestricted dec_enc axiom. Correct 32-byte key roundtrip also checked. This invalidates applicability of the universal contract, not valid-key encryption.

Symbolic.sym.detail: The symbolic Noise suite satisfies its universal Good contract; separate nonempty Session fixtures instantiate its handshake and secrecy laws. This is not a proof of the native suite.

Unforgeable.detail: Real signed-message validity is checked, but universal unforgeability relative to an independent signing history remains open. Neither Signed=True nor a verifier-defined signing history is substituted.

NoSecondPreimage.detail: Closed universal premise for an explicit 32-byte-output model hash and a nonempty attachment. Unique leaf/root outputs are proved against every other input. This model is deliberately not SHA-256.
